Product descriptions, images, and prices are subject to change without notice, though confirmed orders will be honored at the price stated at checkout.

Payment must be made in full at the time of order unless otherwise agreed in writing for trade or bulk accounts. We accept payment methods displayed at checkout. You confirm that the payment information you provide is accurate and that you are authorized to use the selected payment method.

Delivery timelines shown at checkout are estimates only. Risk in the products passes to you upon delivery. Title passes when we receive full payment. We are not responsible for delays caused by events outside our reasonable control, including courier disruption or severe weather.

If you receive damaged, incorrect, or defective goods, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and supporting photos. Approved returns must be unused, in original packaging, and returned within the period stated in our returns policy. Refunds are processed to the original payment method once returned goods are inspected.

Your personal data is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. By using this Site, you consent to the collection and use of information as described there. We take reasonable steps to protect your data but cannot guarantee absolute security of information transmitted over the internet.
